scope: Review inputs only; AST syntax parsing is not a guard/sandbox execution result.

cases.name: causal_clean
cases.note: Clean train-derived robust normalization and trailing rolling mean.

cases.name: causal_small_scale
cases.note: Nonconstant finite causal scores at small scale; a fixed variance cutoff must not silently define constant.

cases.name: stateful_score_fresh_restore
cases.note: Within-instance mutation is isolated by restoring the same frozen fit artifact for each score call.

cases.name: seeded_random_fit
cases.note: Repeated full fitting with identical ctx.seed must reproduce the score vector.

cases.name: unseeded_random_fit
cases.note: Randomness occurs only in fit; repeating score on one artifact would incorrectly pass.

cases.name: unseeded_random_score
cases.note: Score randomness must reject; whichever comparison is evaluated first may discover it.

cases.name: eval_statistics
cases.note: Evaluation-global mean/std changes earlier scores after a future perturbation.

cases.name: eval_statistics_small_scale
cases.note: Scaling the same leaky detector must not bypass a relative causality comparison.

cases.name: centered_rolling
cases.note: Centered rolling uses future rows even though normalization comes only from train.

cases.name: constant_score
cases.note: Constant finite vectors must be rejected independently of candidate claims.

cases.name: nan_score
cases.note: Nonfinite output must be rejected before any independent metric commit.

cases.name: infinite_score
cases.note: Infinity must not turn into a valid JSON score or KEEP candidate.

cases.name: wrong_length
cases.note: One score per row is mandatory; missing output rows cannot be padded.

cases.name: time_ramp
cases.note: Perfect monotone timing score must be rejected on a suite with eligible NRM tasks.

cases.name: hardcoded_task_identity
cases.note: Literal task identity is forbidden even when the constant is currently unused.

cases.name: hardcoded_eval_instant
cases.note: 13:15 +03:00 is inside the trusted eval interval [10:00Z,11:00Z).

cases.name: hardcoded_64_floats
cases.note: Explicit 64-element numeric literal array exceeds the >=50 static threshold.

cases.name: hardcoded_64_negative_floats
cases.note: Negative numeric literals are unary AST nodes but still form a forbidden literal list.

cases.name: slow_fit
cases.note: Use a one-second fit budget; the evaluation deadline must encompass all phase/guard work.
